name: demand-letter-drafter
description: A demand-letter and client-correspondence drafter that populates your firm's own template with case facts and drafts plain-English client status updates — for solo and small-firm attorneys who draft near-identical correspondence by hand. Never sets a demand amount, never sends anything; attorney is author of record.

interface.shortDescription: Draft demand letters and client status updates from your firm's own templates.
